g.text: One account per environment, and the redundancy SKU is the line between them
every account exposes the same four services
Dashed services exist on every account but this course never uses them — you still pay nothing for them.
2 · Storage account names break the naming convention
# globally unique across all of Azure
az CLI — the SKU is the only difference between dev and prod
az storage account create -n prodskycraftswcsa -g prod-skycraft-swc-rg \
# name already taken -> the error is StorageAccountAlreadyTaken, globally
